name: Integration conflict resolver
brief: Propose conflict resolutions that preserve independently established behavior from concurrent agents rather than accepting whichever patch applies.
context: Keep base, branch diffs, interface contracts, and failing integration traces in external REPL variables.
program: Programmatically partition intersecting changes, recursively compare semantic obligations, and assemble a minimal resolution with explicit unresolved conflicts.
data: Use root episodes from competing patches, verified merged implementations, rejected textual merges, and independently replayed counterexamples.
oracle: An isolated build and behavioral test oracle scores retained branch obligations, not merge cleanliness or author agreement.
failure: A clean textual merge that reverses one branch's bounds check must fail despite compiling.
holdout: Hold out repository families, conflict structures, and interacting function pairs from training.
artifact: Produce a conflict-resolution root adapter plus a candidate merge, obligation matrix, and executable verification receipt.

donor_sources.observation: Validates bounded goal hierarchies and combined completion dependencies before importing work.

name: Behavioral test selector
brief: Select the smallest informative test set that can reject a proposed runtime change without hiding untested obligations.
context: Store changed functions, dependency graphs, historical failures, test costs, and contract coverage in REPL variables.
program: Decompose affected obligations recursively, compare test discrimination, and emit an ordered selection with residual coverage gaps.
data: Train root trajectories on seeded regressions, observed test outcomes, coverage relationships, and counterfactual omitted-test failures.
oracle: A withheld full suite and independent mutation matrix determine whether selected tests detect material defects.
failure: Selecting only fast passing tests while omitting the unique overflow detector must score failure.
holdout: Hold out defect classes, dependency shapes, and repositories rather than merely test names.
artifact: Produce a test-selection root adapter, executable test plan, projected cost, and explicit uncovered obligations.

donor_sources.observation: Bounds and normalizes subtask objects, supplying a fallback task when none remain.

name: Flaky test diagnostician

oracle: A fixture controller independently verifies causal classification and whether the proposed intervention removes the underlying failure.
failure: A real race that disappears under slower instrumentation must not be dismissed as harmless flakiness.
holdout: Hold out scheduling patterns, infrastructure perturbations, and test frameworks from training.
artifact: Produce a flakiness-diagnosis root adapter, cause ranking, reproducible witness, and justified repair or quarantine proposal.

donor_sources.observation: Runs sequential scan, methodology, lens, and critique model calls before synthesis.

failure: A mutant that only renames a variable cannot inflate the score as an undetected semantic defect.
holdout: Hold out operator families, numeric boundaries, and source structures when evaluating transfer.
artifact: Produce a mutation-design root adapter, executable mutants, distinguishing tests, and an equivalence-aware coverage report.
